model.title: Fit Future Act
model.meta: Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions Committee, Education and Workforce Committee · Rep. Ryan Mackenzie (R-PA)

summary.text: The bill would establish statutory authority for the President's Council on Sports, Fitness, and Nutrition, a federal advisory committee that provides recommendations on school-based physical education and nutrition. It would require the council to recommend youth fitness goals, strategies for promoting school physical education programs, campaigns to elevate U.S. sports and health, and approaches for reestablishing the Presidential Fitness Test with age- and gender-based exercise benchmarks. The bill would direct the Department of Health and Human Services to provide funding and support to the council, which could also receive funds from the National Fitness Foundation.
